name: PLP Editorial Card
description: Shoppable editorial interlink inserted at a deterministic position in a merchandising grid.

attribute_definition_groups.name: PLP Editorial Card
attribute_definition_groups.description: Shoppable editorial interlink inserted at a deterministic position in a merchandising grid.

attribute_definitions.name: Position after product
attribute_definitions.description: Insert after this many products. Use 0 to place the card before the first product.

attribute_definitions.name: Desktop column span
attribute_definitions.description: Number of desktop grid columns occupied by the editorial card.

attribute_definitions.name: Mobile column span
attribute_definitions.description: Occupy one or both columns in the mobile product grid.

attribute_definitions.name: Row span
attribute_definitions.description: Use two rows for a taller editorial treatment.

attribute_definitions.name: Eyebrow
attribute_definitions.description: Optional short label displayed above the title.

attribute_definitions.name: Image
attribute_definitions.description: Editorial image selected from the content library.

attribute_definitions.name: Image alternative text
attribute_definitions.description: Describe informative imagery. If empty, the title is used.

attribute_definitions.name: Decorative image
attribute_definitions.description: Enable when the image adds no information beyond the text.

attribute_definitions.name: Link label
attribute_definitions.description: Accessible label for the editorial interlink.

attribute_definitions.name: Link destination
attribute_definitions.description: Product, category, landing page or other safe destination.

attribute_definitions.name: Content layout
attribute_definitions.description: Place content below the image or over it in a readable panel.

attribute_definitions.name: Link style
attribute_definitions.description: Semantic storefront treatment for the link.
